meta.title: Composio AI Product Ops — Take-home Case Study
meta.author: Pranav Dhiran

rows.one_line: Enterprise CRM and platform-as-a-service with an extremely broad set of APIs for managing accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and custom objects.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page is marketing, not API docs; auth and MCP claims based on well-known platform knowledge. Very broad but requires Connected App setup.

rows.one_line: All-in-one CRM platform (marketing, sales, service, CMS) with a broad REST API and date-based versioning.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page confirmed versioning model only; OAuth/private-app token and MCP details from knowledge. Solid, low-friction integration target.

rows.one_line: Sales pipeline CRM with a RESTful API (v1 and v2) covering deals, leads, activities, projects, and reporting.
rows.agent_notes: No official MCP found; verdict otherwise straightforward. API requires a paid/trial account for ongoing access.

rows.one_line: Highly customizable, data-driven CRM with a REST API, real-time webhooks, an app SDK, and native MCP support.
rows.agent_notes: Docs explicitly document MCP and webhooks; very buildable. Token vs OAuth details standard for modern SaaS.

rows.one_line: Open-source, self-hostable CRM platform (React/TypeScript/PostgreSQL) with REST and GraphQL APIs and built-in agent/MCP support.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched text confirms open-source, self-hostable, MCP. Endpoint specifics and webhook details not in the fetched page - based on knowledge.

rows.one_line: Customizable work-management platform (owned by Citrix) whose entire frontend is built on a fully exposed REST API with webhooks.
rows.agent_notes: No official MCP; everything else confirmed from fetched docs.

rows.one_line: Full-featured CRM by Zoho with a REST API (v6) covering sales, marketing, service, and custom modules.
rows.agent_notes: No text file fetched for this app - all fields from knowledge. OAuth client setup and developer edition provisioning add some setup time.

rows.one_line: Inside-sales CRM with a full developer platform: REST API, OAuth2, webhooks/event log, and a first-party MCP server.
rows.agent_notes: Fully confirmed from fetched text including first-party MCP server. Only friction is the paid plan requirement.

rows.one_line: Google-integrated CRM with a RESTful 'Developer API' (JSON) covering people, companies, opportunities, tasks, and leads.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page focused on getting started/Postman; auth method specifics (API key header vs OAuth) from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Enterprise deal-management and investment CRM with a partner/enterprise REST API, Python SDK, and an announced MCP server.
rows.agent_notes: Docs are excellent and MCP is officially coming, but credentials require an enterprise/partner relationship - main friction.

rows.one_line: Customer support platform with a very broad set of REST APIs across Support, Help Center, Talk, Chat, Sell, Messaging, and apps.
rows.agent_notes: API breadth and products confirmed from fetched text. Needs a trial/paid account plus subdomain; no official MCP.

rows.one_line: Customer service and engagement platform (help desk, messenger, tickets, AI) with REST APIs and a free development workspace.
rows.agent_notes: Free dev workspace makes first call fast. Official MCP existence is my only slight uncertainty.

rows.one_line: Cloud helpdesk with a comprehensive REST API (v2) covering tickets, contacts, conversations, solutions, and admin objects.
rows.agent_notes: Full API reference fetched; only webhook and MCP details are from knowledge rather than the fetched page.

rows.one_line: Shared inbox and customer communication platform for support teams, with a Core API giving comprehensive control over contacts, conversations, and messages.
rows.agent_notes: Webhook support and MCP existence inferred from knowledge, not the fetched text.

rows.one_line: Agentic B2B support platform that tracks customer issues across Slack, email, Microsoft Teams, chat widgets, and forms, and orchestrates AI agents to resolve them.
rows.agent_notes: Text confirms B2B positioning and API/MCP existence but does not state the exact auth method or free-tier availability.

rows.one_line: Omnichannel help desk and live chat platform with ticketing, knowledge base, social, and call center capabilities.
rows.agent_notes: Docs page fetch failed (404). API v4 existence confirmed via product update text; webhook support inferred from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Modern B2B customer support platform with a GraphQL API that mirrors the full UI (no API limitations), plus an official MCP server.
rows.agent_notes: Free-tier availability uncertain; webhook support inferred from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Help desk and shared-inbox platform with a Mailbox API (v2 current) covering conversations, customers, mailboxes, reports, workflows, and webhooks.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page was legacy v1 docs; v2 noted as current. OAuth2 support inferred from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk that unifies email, chat, SMS, voice, and social channels with a REST API for tickets, customers, and automations.
rows.agent_notes: Thin fetched text; auth methods, webhooks, and plan details from knowledge of Gorgias docs.

rows.one_line: Enterprise customer-service platform with a REST API, Lookup API, chat SDKs, and webhooks for building support integrations.
rows.agent_notes: Thin fetched text; exact auth method and credential self-service status inferred.

rows.one_line: Team messaging and collaboration platform with a very broad REST API, Events API, webhooks, and Socket Mode for building bots and apps.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched text is marketing-ish landing page; API surface and MCP evidence from strong prior knowledge.

rows.one_line: Cloud communications platform whose REST APIs let developers send messages, make calls, and look up numbers across SMS, voice, video, and more.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched text confirms REST broadly; auth method and MCP evidence from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Zoho's team collaboration chat platform with a REST API for users, teams, channels, chats, messages, bots, reminders, events, and files.
rows.agent_notes: Text lists V3 as latest but intro text references /v2/ path; webhook support inferred from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Larksuite's collaboration and chat suite (IM, Docs, Calendar, Base, Wiki, Meetings) with broad server-side REST APIs, events/webhooks, and an open-source CLI.
rows.agent_notes: 024_lark_larksuite.txt was a JS shell; relied on 024_lark.txt plus knowledge. MCP/official status inferred.

rows.one_line: Free Slack-alternative team chat app with channels, threads, direct messages, and guest access.
rows.agent_notes: Lack of public API is consistent with Pumble's current offerings; could not confirm from docs since none exist.

rows.one_line: Community messaging platform with a very broad REST API, Gateway WebSocket, webhooks, and bot framework for building apps that run inside servers.
rows.agent_notes: Thin fetched text; content based on established Discord developer documentation.

rows.one_line: Messaging platform whose Bot API lets bots send/receive messages, media, and updates programmatically over HTTP.
rows.agent_notes: No real uncertainty. Token auth means no OAuth flow; easiest app in the batch.

rows.one_line: Meta's platform for businesses to message customers at scale via the Cloud API (Graph API endpoints).
rows.agent_notes: Fastest path is the auto-created test WABA; production needs verification and app review.

rows.one_line: Cloud phone system for sales/support teams, exposed via a broad REST API for users, calls, contacts, and numbers.
rows.agent_notes: Main friction is needing a paid Aircall account; API itself is well documented.

rows.one_line: Cloud communications API provider (SMS, voice, video, messages, verify) for programmatic messaging and calls.
rows.agent_notes: Thin fetched text; auth/detail confirmed from domain knowledge of developer.vonage.com.

rows.one_line: Google's ad platform, manageable programmatically via the Google Ads API (gRPC/JSON-REST) down to keyword level.
rows.agent_notes: Production developer token approval is the main time sink; test accounts make sandbox calls possible quickly.

rows.one_line: Meta's Marketing API (Graph API endpoints) for creating and managing ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
rows.agent_notes: App review for advanced access is the friction point; test ad accounts enable sandbox calls immediately.

rows.one_line: LinkedIn's Marketing API for managing ad campaigns, reporting, audiences, and lead sync on the professional network.
rows.agent_notes: Marketing API approval is the slowest gate in this batch; core profile APIs are open but ads APIs are restricted.

rows.one_line: White-label CRM and marketing automation platform for agencies, with a REST API for contacts, campaigns, and funnels.
rows.agent_notes: Thin fetched text; docs now live at developer.leadconnectorhq.com. API key auth is the fast path.

rows.one_line: Email marketing and automation platform (Intuit) with a broad REST API for audiences, campaigns, automations, and reporting.
rows.agent_notes: One of the easiest: instant API key on a free account.

rows.one_line: E-commerce marketing automation platform with a JSON:API REST API for profiles, events, campaigns, flows, and catalogs.
rows.agent_notes: Private API key path is trivial; OAuth for partner-grade integration.

rows.one_line: All-in-one funnel builder, email marketing, and online-course platform with a REST API for contacts, funnels, and campaigns.
rows.agent_notes: API is real and documented (OpenAPI available via developer.systeme.io/llms.txt); uncertainty is whether free plan gets API keys and full endpoint access.

rows.one_line: Visual discovery platform whose API v5 lets developers build apps for pins, boards, ads, and shopping.
rows.agent_notes: App review is the main delay; test tokens and sandbox speed up initial development.

rows.one_line: Meta's text-first social network, with a free REST API to publish posts, retrieve media/profiles, moderate replies, and read insights.
rows.agent_notes: Thin fetched text; API is new and narrower than other Meta products. No MCP ecosystem yet.

rows.one_line: Twilio-owned email delivery platform that sends transactional and marketing email at scale via a broad REST API.
rows.agent_notes: Simple API key auth, free tier available; the fetched page was mostly navigation but the API reference is well documented.

rows.one_line: Cloud commerce platform whose Admin API (REST + GraphQL) lets you manage stores, products, orders, customers, and apps.
rows.agent_notes: Auth is OAuth with scopes; free dev store makes it fully self-serve. Very broad and well documented.

rows.one_line: Free, open-source WordPress e-commerce plugin with a REST API for managing products, orders, customers, and store data.
rows.agent_notes: Self-hosted: a dev must stand up a WooCommerce store to get credentials, but it's free and un-gated. Auth is simple key-based.

rows.one_line: SaaS e-commerce platform with broad REST Management APIs, GraphQL Storefront API, and webhooks for managing stores programmatically.
rows.agent_notes: Simple token auth via API Accounts; free trial store makes first call quick. Official MCP server exists.

rows.one_line: Salesforce's enterprise B2C/B2B commerce platform exposed through Open Commerce API (OCAPI) and Commerce Cloud APIs.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page rendered nothing useful; buildability gated by enterprise sales process and paid subscription, not by API quality.

rows.one_line: Open-source (Magento Open Source) and commercial (Adobe Commerce) e-commerce platform with a broad REST API and GraphQL.
rows.agent_notes: Auth is flexible but token generation requires admin access to a store; self-hosting Open Source is the free path. Webhooks only on commercial editions.

rows.one_line: Website and commerce platform whose Commerce APIs (Orders, Inventory, Products, Fulfillment, Customers, Transactions) integrate store data.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page detailed the Contacts/Commerce API scope model; commerce breadth and webhooks partially inferred. OAuth + API key both supported.

rows.one_line: E-commerce platform (now Lightspeed) whose REST API manages products, orders, customers, categories, discounts and store settings.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page is a docs index; free plan + permanent access token makes first call fast. Auth is simple.

rows.one_line: Self-serve platform for selling digital products whose OAuth API manages products, sales, payouts, licenses, emails and subscriptions.
rows.agent_notes: Docs are thin but the fetched page was substantive; OAuth + token generation is instant and free. Moderate breadth.

rows.one_line: Amazon's API for sellers/vendors to manage listings, orders, inventory, fulfillment, pricing, reports and merchant services at scale.
rows.agent_notes: Auth is the most complex (LWA + SigV4 + IAM + per-role registration). Self-serve but registration/approval per role adds days; needs a paid professional seller account.

rows.one_line: Creator monetization platform (apparently rebranded to Commas) for selling courses, communities, webinars and memberships.
rows.agent_notes: Very obscure; the fetched page shows fanbasis is now Commas with enterprise-gated APIs. Treat as blocked/insufficient info unless an enterprise agreement is secured.

rows.one_line: Paid SEO data API provider covering SERP, keywords, on-page, backlinks, domain analytics, rank tracking and more.
rows.agent_notes: Auth is simple basic-auth login/password from the dashboard; free trial makes first call fast. Cost scales with usage but no approval gate.

rows.one_line: SEO/AEO platform whose REST API exposes keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, site audits and AI-visibility data at scale.
rows.agent_notes: Simple API-key auth, free trial available; the main cost is the paid plan. Official MCP server is a bonus. No webhooks.

rows.one_line: SEO tool for keyword research, backlink analysis and rank tracking, exposed via a commercial REST API.
rows.agent_notes: Auth is simple API key; cost is the main friction ($$$ paid plans). MCP officially documented.

rows.one_line: Self-serve AI web scraping platform with API, CLI, SDKs and MCP server for extracting structured data.
rows.agent_notes: Official MCP server exists, so an integration can wrap the REST API or proxy the MCP server directly.

rows.one_line: Web scraping and automation platform with an actor marketplace, run via a REST API or SDK clients.
rows.agent_notes: Very well-documented API; free tier makes first call trivial.

rows.one_line: Web scraping/crawling API that turns any website into LLM-ready markdown or structured data.
rows.agent_notes: Official MCP server exists; easy free-tier start.

rows.one_line: Enterprise web data platform with proxy network, prebuilt scrapers, data feeds and web unblocking APIs.
rows.agent_notes: Landing-page fetched text; free tier exists but product is enterprise-oriented, so verification of token flow needed.

rows.one_line: Open-source CLI that hunts down social media accounts by username across 400+ networks.
rows.agent_notes: Not a SaaS; integration would mean wrapping the CLI locally, not calling an external API.

rows.one_line: B2B contact and company data platform offering prospector, contact/phone enrichment and job-change APIs.
rows.agent_notes: API is documented on the site but credentials require sales contact; API key header name varies (x-api-key vs x-waterfall-api-key) between examples.

rows.one_line: No-code GTM data enrichment and automation platform (with Claygent AI) for finding and enriching contacts.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched page was marketing/learning material, not API docs; Clay's public API is limited, so treat integration as partial.

rows.one_line: Code hosting and collaboration platform with a very broad REST and GraphQL API for repos, issues, PRs and Actions.
rows.agent_notes: Trivially buildable; PAT or OAuth2 both work; official MCP server available.

rows.one_line: Frontend deployment and serverless platform whose REST API manages deployments, domains, env vars and projects.
rows.agent_notes: Clean auth and docs; access token self-serve.

rows.one_line: Static and serverless hosting platform with a REST API for atomic deploys, forms, DNS, env vars and site management.
rows.agent_notes: Well-documented; note password resets invalidate PATs.

rows.one_line: CDN, DNS, security and edge-computing platform with one of the broadest REST APIs in the industry.
rows.agent_notes: Huge API surface; scoped tokens make safe integrations straightforward.

rows.one_line: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres database with REST (PostgREST) and GraphQL APIs, auth, storage and realtime.
rows.agent_notes: Instant keys on project creation; REST via PostgREST is straightforward to target.

rows.one_line: Graph database for storing and querying highly connected data, available self-hosted or as managed Aura cloud.
rows.agent_notes: Auth is DB-native (bolt/basic), not REST OAuth. Build integration around Cypher queries via HTTP transactional endpoint or a driver.

rows.one_line: Cloud data platform/warehouse with SQL analytics, data sharing, and AI/ML workloads.
rows.agent_notes: Docs text was a 404 page. Account/trial creation plus admin-configured roles make first call slower than typical SaaS.

rows.one_line: Managed cloud MongoDB database service with cluster management, search, and vector/embedding APIs.
rows.agent_notes: Admin API is purely for cluster/org admin; app-level data access is via MongoDB driver/connection strings.

rows.one_line: Cloud monitoring and observability platform for metrics, logs, APM, dashboards, and alerts.
rows.agent_notes: None. Official MCP presence confirmed directly in fetched docs navigation.

rows.one_line: Error tracking and application performance monitoring platform.
rows.agent_notes: Official MCP is community-edition open source; still verifiable existence.

rows.one_line: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and databases.
rows.agent_notes: Internal integration must be explicitly granted page/database access in the workspace.

rows.one_line: Low-code relational database that blends spreadsheets with app-building.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched text was short (intro page only); auth fields rely on knowledge.

rows.one_line: Issue tracking and project management designed for software teams.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched text was short; API breadth based on knowledge of the GraphQL schema.

rows.one_line: Issue tracking and agile project management by Atlassian.
rows.agent_notes: API token + site URL is the fastest path for a solo dev; OAuth for multi-user apps.

rows.one_line: Work management platform for teams to plan and track projects and tasks.
rows.agent_notes: Embedded API explorer and free account make first call fast; advanced features gated to paid tiers.

rows.one_line: Work OS where teams build and customize boards, items, and workflows without code.
rows.agent_notes: Free-trial account needed; guest access requires OAuth flow.

rows.one_line: All-in-one project management and team collaboration platform.
rows.agent_notes: Official MCP server existence directly confirmed in fetched docs text.

rows.one_line: Collaborative document platform combining docs, spreadsheets, and apps (now Superhuman Docs).
rows.agent_notes: Coda was acquired by Superhuman; docs now branded 'Superhuman Docs' but API and docs URL remain coda.io.

rows.one_line: Cloud-based work management and collaboration platform with a REST API for programmatically managing sheets, rows, reports, and automation.
rows.agent_notes: Auth method (OAuth2 + PAT) and paid-only model well established; endpoint breadth from knowledge, not fetched text.

rows.one_line: Time tracking and invoicing SaaS with a v2 REST API for timesheets, projects, clients, expenses, invoices, estimates, and reports.
rows.agent_notes: Fetched text thin (<1200 chars) — API surface list confirmed but auth details (OAuth2 vs PAT) from domain knowledge; no webhook support is known to be absent in v2.

rows.one_line: Global payments and financial infrastructure platform with a very broad REST API for payments, billing, subscriptions, payouts, and connect.
rows.agent_notes: Confident on all fields from fetched API reference text.

rows.one_line: Open finance and bank data aggregation API providing account, transaction, balance, identity, asset, income, and payment data from financial institutions.
rows.agent_notes: Production is gated (request via Dashboard), but sandbox is instantly buildable — verdict buildable_today with that caveat.

rows.one_line: World's largest cryptocurrency exchange with a very broad REST + WebSocket API for spot, margin, futures, wallet, and market data.
rows.agent_notes: Auth details confirmed from fetched developer docs; webhook absence is from domain knowledge of Binance architecture.

rows.one_line: NMI-powered embedded payment gateway aimed at ISOs and SaaS platforms; highly obscure with no discoverable public developer API.
rows.agent_notes: Insufficient public information to verify auth, endpoints, or self-serve access. Recommend treating as blocked pending direct vendor contact.

rows.one_line: iPayX Protocol is a FINTRAC-registered FX verification/forensic audit tool that compares applied bank FX rates against mid-market rates — appears to be a consumer web app with no documented public API.
rows.agent_notes: May simply be a consumer product without an API at all; verify with the vendor before investing.

rows.one_line: SMB accounting platform with the very broad QuickBooks Online Accounting REST API covering invoices, payments, customers, items, bills, and reports.
rows.agent_notes: Sandbox is buildable quickly; production requires QuickBooks subscription + app approval — hence buildable_with_work.

rows.one_line: Online accounting software with a very broad REST API covering accounting, payroll, files, projects, bank feeds, and assets.
rows.agent_notes: OAuth flow well-documented; friction is app registration plus paid/trial organisation and scope approvals.

rows.one_line: Corporate card and spend management platform with a REST API covering accounting, budgets, expenses, payments, team, transactions, and travel.
rows.agent_notes: API surface and MCP confirmed from fetched text; account/approval requirements and OAuth2+key mix from knowledge.

rows.one_line: Corporate spend and expense management platform with a REST API for transactions, reimbursements, vendors, cards, and accounting exports.
rows.agent_notes: API-key auth and webhook support from knowledge of Ramp docs; account gating makes it buildable_with_work rather than buildable_today.

rows.one_line: Private market data and analytics platform whose Research API provides programmatic access to company, deal, fund, investor, and document data.
rows.agent_notes: Page fetch blocked by bot protection; partnership-gating is well-established domain knowledge for PitchBook data access.

rows.one_line: Google's AI-powered notebook that answers questions and generates summaries/notes grounded in your uploaded documents.
rows.agent_notes: High confidence that NotebookLM has no public API. Community MCPs exist but are unofficial and can break; building on them is unsupported.

rows.one_line: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings with live notes and chat.
rows.agent_notes: API surface and MCP existence not confirmed from public docs; limited public API per assignment hint

rows.one_line: AI meeting notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings and syncs notes to CRMs.
rows.agent_notes: API details thin; consumer product historically without public API, MCP/API now advertised

rows.one_line: AI-powered academic search engine that searches and summarizes findings from millions of research papers.
rows.agent_notes: No fetched docs available; verdict relies on assignment hint (OAuth 'requested', blocked/insufficient-info)

rows.one_line: Agentic document platform that parses, classifies, extracts, and edits documents at enterprise scale.
rows.agent_notes: Self-serve trial specifics (free credits) assumed; API key + MCP confirmed from docs

rows.one_line: Autonomous AI software engineer by Cognition that writes, runs, and tests code.
rows.agent_notes: Devin API surface is new/limited; MCP confirmed from docs index

rows.one_line: AI-native creative suite for generating images, videos, and marketing content across 30+ models.
rows.agent_notes: New product, thin docs; REST API surface not clearly documented, access mainly via MCP/CLI

rows.one_line: Open-source command-line tool that converts Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF files.
rows.agent_notes: Not a SaaS API — must be executed locally; integrate via subprocess or Node.js API

rows.one_line: Paid REST API and MCP for YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists at scale.
rows.agent_notes: Docs complete; API key + REST + MCP all confirmed from fetched text

rows.one_line: AI meeting notetaker that captures, transcribes, and enriches meetings for teams and AI agents.
rows.agent_notes: MCP/API existence confirmed from homepage; auth specifics (OAuth) and gating of API access not fully documented
